feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR Politics for nonpartisan coverage of government, elections, policy debates and voting rights. Plus weekday audio from The NPR Politics Podcast.

entry.title: What's the future of the Democratic party in Texas, amid historic midterm wins?
entry.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with former Texas state Sen. Wendy Davis, a Democrat, about Texas flipping blue and what it means for future elections.

entry.title: South Carolina winner Annie Andrews talks about her win and the path ahead
entry.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with Democrat Dr. Annie Andrews, who bested Republican candidate Darline Graham, the incumbent and sister of the late Sen. Lindsey Graham.

entry.title: Where voters stand on state ballot measures, from abortion to LGBTQ rights to guns
entry.summary: Voters in dozens of states considered 146 statewide ballot measures this midterm cycle, on topics spanning LGBTQ rights, wealth taxes, abortion, redistricting, guns and more.

entry.title: Rahm Emanuel maps out a vision for what Democrats can achieve after taking Congress
entry.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with former congressman and Obama advisor Rahm Emanuel about what Democrats' strategy should be, now that they'll soon control both houses of Congress.

entry.title: Democrats sweeping victories mean big changes for Trump's final two years in office
entry.summary: Democrats' wins in the House and Senate mean a new power dynamic is coming to Washington.

entry.title: Elon Musk will face scrutiny from Democrats after midterms
entry.summary: Democrats are likely to launch investigations into Musk's influence, including his leadership of DOGE and government contracts

entry.title: Democratic leaders reflect on midterm results and what's next for the party
entry.summary: Democratic party leaders and political analysts spoke with Morning Edition about the results of the midterm elections, the effects of mid-decade redistricting efforts, and the next steps for the party.

entry.title: It was a big night for doctors to win seats in Congress, riding the blue wave
entry.summary: Historically, most physicians who served in the House or Senate have been Republicans. In the next Congress, physicians who are Democrats made significant gains.

entry.title: Navajo voters hop tractors, make extraordinary efforts to vote after widespread flooding
entry.summary: Four weeks of flooding washed out roads and sent thousands fleeing their homes on the Navajo Reservation. But many worked hard to get to polling places and voting day became part of the recovery process.

entry.title: Chuck Schumer heralds Democrats' 'generational remake' of Senate
entry.summary: In remarks the day after his party flipped control of Congress, the Senate Minority Leader said voters had spoken clearly about their priorities, and said it's up to the Democratic party to deliver.
